6: # Ask CrewAI Docs
7: 
8: Answer CrewAI questions by looking up the official documentation at `docs.crewai.com`.
9: 
10: ---
11: 
12: ## When to Use This Skill
13: 
14: Use this skill when:
15: 
16: - The user asks about a CrewAI feature, parameter, or behavior not covered in detail by the other skills
17: - You need to verify current API syntax, method signatures, or configuration options
18: - The user hits an error and needs troubleshooting guidance from official docs
19: - The question is about a newer or less common CrewAI feature (e.g., telemetry, testing, CLI commands, deployment, enterprise features)
20: - The question is about experimental conversational Flows and you need the current `handle_turn()`, `ConversationConfig`, `RouterConfig`, tracing, or streaming behavior
21: - You're unsure whether your knowledge is current — the docs reflect the latest published state
22: 
23: **Do NOT use this skill** when the question is clearly answered by one of the other skills (getting-started, design-agent, design-task). Those skills contain curated, opinionated guidance. This skill is for filling gaps and verifying details.
24: 
25: ---
26: 
27: ## How to Query the Docs
28: 
29: ### Step 1: Fetch the docs index
30: 
31: The CrewAI docs site publishes an `llms.txt` file — a structured index of every documentation page with descriptions. Fetch it first to find the right page:
32: 
33: ```
34: WebFetch: https://docs.crewai.com/llms.txt
35: ```
36: 
37: This returns a categorized list of all doc pages in the format:
38: 
39: ```
40: - [Page Title](https://docs.crewai.com/path/to/page): "Description of what the page covers"
41: ```
42: 
43: Categories include:
44: - **API Reference** — REST endpoints (kickoff, status, resume, inputs)
45: - **Concepts** — agents, crews, tasks, tools, flows, memory, knowledge, LLMs, processes, training, testing
46: - **Enterprise** — RBAC, SSO, automations, traces, deployment, triggers, integrations
47: - **Tools Library** — 40+ tools organized by category (AI/ML, automation, cloud, database, files, search, web scraping)
48: - **MCP Integration** — MCP server setup, transports, DSL, security
49: - **Examples & Cookbooks** — practical implementations
50: - **Learning Paths** — tutorials and advanced topics
51: - **Observability** — monitoring integrations
52: 
53: For conversational Flow questions, go directly to:
54: 
55: ```
56: WebFetch: https://docs.crewai.com/en/guides/flows/conversational-flows
57: ```
58: 
59: Treat this page as the source of truth for the experimental `crewai.experimental.conversational` surface. Verify it before answering detailed API questions because the feature may change before it graduates.
60: 
61: ### Step 2: Fetch the relevant page
62: 
63: Once you identify the right page from the index, fetch its content:
64: 
65: ```
66: WebFetch: https://docs.crewai.com/<path-from-index>
67: ```
68: 
69: ### Step 3: Synthesize and cite
70: 
71: Combine what you find from the docs with context from the other skills to give a clear, actionable response. Always include the docs URL so the user can read further.
72: 
73: ---
74: 
75: ## Workflow Summary
76: 
77: 1. **Understand the user's question** — what specific CrewAI concept, API, or behavior are they asking about?
78: 2. **Fetch `llms.txt`** — scan the index to find the most relevant page(s)
79: 3. **Fetch the page(s)** — retrieve the actual documentation content
80: 4. **Synthesize the answer** — combine docs content with context from other skills
81: 5. **Cite the source** — include the docs URL in your response
82: 
83: ---
84: 
85: ## For an Even Better Experience
86: 
87: Users who frequently query CrewAI docs can configure the CrewAI docs MCP server in their coding agent for richer, structured search:
88: 
89: ```
90: https://docs.crewai.com/mcp
91: ```
92: 
93: This is optional — the `llms.txt` workflow above works without any setup.
94: 
95: ---
96: 
97: ## Examples of Good Use Cases
98: 
99: | User Question | Why This Skill |
100: |---|---|
101: | "What parameters does `Crew()` accept?" | Specific API reference — docs are authoritative |
102: | "How do I set up telemetry in CrewAI?" | Niche feature not covered in other skills |
103: | "What's the difference between `Process.sequential` and `Process.hierarchical`?" | Detailed comparison best sourced from docs |
104: | "I'm getting `ValidationError` when using `output_pydantic`" | Troubleshooting — docs may have known issues or caveats |
105: | "How do I deploy a CrewAI flow to production?" | Deployment guidance lives in docs, not in design skills |
106: | "What CLI commands does `crewai` support?" | CLI reference is a docs concern |
107: | "How do I configure memory for a crew?" | Detailed config options beyond what design-agent covers |
108: | "What tools are available for web scraping?" | Tools library reference |
109: | "How do I set up SSO for CrewAI enterprise?" | Enterprise features live in docs |
110: | "How do I build a chat app with Flow.handle_turn()?" | Experimental conversational Flow API; verify the latest guide |
111:
